repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(any(#AirQualitySensor).airQualitySensor_fineDustLevel <= 80)
triggered = false
}
wait until(any(#AirQualitySensor).airQualitySensor_fineDustLevel > 80)
all(#AirPurifier).airPurifier_setAirPurifierMode("high")
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a rising-edge wait on a slot declared as `any` (existential), meaning the action should fire if *any* device satisfies the condition. The candidate incorrectly uses `all` (universal) in both the rearm and trigger waits, requiring *all* devices to be below 80 and then *all* to be above 80. Evidence F2 shows the IR fired at t=0 because `Living_AQ` was 80.1 (satisfying the existential condition), but the JoI did not fire because `Bedroom_AQ` was null (failing the universal condition).
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced `all` with `any` in the wait conditions to match the binding slot quantifier. This ensures the rising edge triggers when at least one sensor exceeds the threshold, and the rearm waits for at least one sensor to drop below it, preserving the IR's existential semantics.
